# Implementation Plan: Gestão de Contas a Pagar e Receber

**Branch**: `006-accounts-payable-receivable` | **Date**: 2026-08-23 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/006-accounts-payable-receivable/spec.md`

**Note**: This file is generated by `/speckit-plan`; the artifact definitions below drive the implementation.

## Summary

Add a condominium financial module (accounts payable and receivable). The `syndic`
registers, edits, cancels, and settles expense accounts (contas a pagar) and revenue
accounts (contas a receber), with fixed categories per type, mandatory due dates, and
amounts greater than zero. Accounts with a past due date are automatically shown as
`Em Atraso` (derived, not persisted). A dashboard shows totals a receber/a pagar for
the month and saldo previsto vs. realizado. Residents see only the receivables tied to
their unit and an aggregated financial-health view. No boleto/Pix generation, no
automated notifications, no bulk import in v1; settlement always requires the
transaction date; records are retained for at least 5 years.

Technical direction for this feature: **standard library first** (no web frameworks, no
ORM, no migration framework), **CSS-first over JavaScript**, and the
constitution-mandated GOTTH presentation stack (Go + Templ + Tailwind + HTMX). All
list/filter/summary logic is plain SQL over one new table; money is stored as integer
cents; `Em Atraso` is computed at query time rather than persisted.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Go 1.27 (module `github.com/leoarkiteto/zelo`), using the Go
standard library as the primary toolset.

**Primary Dependencies**:
- `github.com/a-h/templ` — server-rendered templates (constitution-mandated)
- Tailwind CSS + HTMX — CSS-first styling and minimal progressive enhancement
  (constitution-mandated)
- `github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/stdlib` — PostgreSQL driver registered with stdlib
  `database/sql` (driver only; no ORM)

**Storage**: PostgreSQL (local `docker-compose.yml` container) accessed via
`database/sql` + `pgx` stdlib driver and plain SQL. New table: `finance_accounts`.
Existing tables reused: `condominiums`, `units`, `unit_occupancies`, `users`,
`audit_events`. Receipt attachments (comprovantes) are stored on the server filesystem
under a new `UPLOAD_DIR` config (default `uploads/`) and served only through an
authenticated syndic route — never from the public static path.

**Testing**: stdlib only — `testing`, `net/http/httptest`, and integration tests against
the dockerized PostgreSQL. TDD is mandatory: finance tests are written first.

**Target Platform**: Linux server (server-rendered web application).

**Project Type**: web application (server-side GOTTH stack; no client-side SPA).

**Performance Goals**: Finance list, filters, and dashboard render in under 1 second for
a typical condominium (hundreds to a few thousand accounts per year); account creation
completes in under 1 minute of user time (spec SC-001).

**Constraints**:
- Standard library first: no web framework, no ORM, no session/migration/CSRF frameworks.
- CSS-first over JavaScript: presentation and interaction state come from Tailwind CSS;
  HTMX is used only for server-driven partial updates required by the GOTTH stack.
- CSRF protection on all state-changing routes (existing synchronizer-token middleware).
- Migrations are plain forward-only SQL files applied by the existing minimal runner.
- Vertical slice isolation: the `finance` slice spans `core/{domain,ports,services}` →
  `handlers` → `repositories` → `templates` only, and reaches other code only through
  `internal/shared/*`.
- No client-side SPA framework.
- UI text is available in both `en` and `pt-br` through the existing i18n catalog.

**Scale/Scope**: Single condominium per user session; hundreds of accounts per month and
multi-year history (5-year minimum retention); one category list fixed by account type.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Notes |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| I. GOTTH Stack | PASS | Go server + Templ + Tailwind + HTMX; no SPA. Finance pages are server-rendered HTML with HTMX only for progressive enhancement. |
| II. Modular Monolith with Hexagonal Architecture | PASS | Finance use cases live in `internal/features/finance/core/services` and depend only on ports (interfaces); persistence adapters in `repositories/`; HTTP in `handlers/`; domain types in `core/domain`. |
| III. Vertical Slice Feature Isolation | PASS | Finance slice spans handler → service → store for this feature only; shared code restricted to `internal/shared/*`. |
| IV. Test-First Development (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | PASS | Tests written first with stdlib `testing`/`httptest`; integration tests cover create/edit/cancel/settle, overdue derivation, filters, dashboard math, resident views, access control, and the `0009_create_finance_accounts.sql` migration. |
| V. SOLID, Design Patterns & Generated Code | PASS | Generated `*_templ.go` and Tailwind output produced only by `scripts/`; no hand edits to generated artifacts. |
| VI. Standard Library First & CSS-First | PASS | `database/sql` + plain SQL; no ORM, no search engine, no payment SDK; CSS-first with HTMX limited to progressive enhancement. |
| Repository Layout & Conventions | PASS | Follows `internal/features/<feature>/` vertical slice layout documented in the constitution; migration `0009` committed forward-only. |

**Gate result**: PASS — no violations requiring justification.

**Post-design re-check (after Phase 1)**: Still PASS. The data model adds one
plain-SQL-friendly table (`finance_accounts`), derives `overdue` in queries, stores
money as integer cents, and keeps receipt files on the filesystem behind an
authenticated route — all implementable with `database/sql` and the existing GOTTH
stack, leaving the core framework-free.

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
cmd/web/
└── main.go                        # wire finance repositories/service/handlers; register routes
internal/
├── features/
│   └── finance/                   # NEW vertical slice (self-contained)
│       ├── core/
│       │   ├── domain/            # AccountType, AccountStatus, Category, FinancialAccount,
│       │   │                      #   money parsing, validation & status-transition rules
│       │   ├── ports/             # AccountStore, SummaryStore, UnitResolver, AuditRecorder ports
│       │   └── services/          # FinanceService: create/edit/cancel/settle, list, summary
│       ├── handlers/              # deps.go, routes.go, finance.go, receipt.go
│       ├── repositories/          # accounts.go — database/sql adapter for finance_accounts
│       └── templates/             # finance.templ (+ generated *_templ.go), smoke_test.go
├── shared/
│   ├── config/config.go           # add UploadDir (UPLOAD_DIR, default "uploads/")
│   ├── i18n/catalog.go            # add finance.* keys (en + pt-br)
│   └── ...                        # middleware/httpx/store reused unchanged
migrations/
└── 0009_create_finance_accounts.sql  # finance_accounts + indexes + audit event allow-list
```

**Structure Decision**: Single server-rendered web application, one new vertical slice
(`finance`) added alongside the existing `auth`, `directory`, `management`, `home`, and
`profile` slices. Receipt file storage and the i18n catalog are shared concerns touched
only through `internal/shared/config` and `internal/shared/i18n`.
